thread:
maya: Heads-up — I'm starting conversion for the 'orion-lite' checkpoint. Found a couple weird things: weights are in s3://redwood-models/orion-lite/v1/ but tokenizer.json seems to have unk token as <unk> while our loader expects <|unk|>. Also shard layout looks like TP-first ordering instead of the usual interleaved layout. can someone ping a quick sanity check? :eyes:

tariq: pinged. do you have the original HF config and a sample shard file?

maya: yes — hf config at s3://redwood-models/orion-lite/v1/config.json, sample shard s3://redwood-models/orion-lite/v1/weights-00001.safetensors. I ran safetensors inspect and it lists keys like 'transformer.h.0.attn.k.weight.tp0' (so TP chunk prefix).

simon: ok that TP prefix means the exporter split by tensor-parallel rank first. our packager expects interleaved shards: weights split across dims, not named by tp rank. conversion path will need a rekey step + reshape. jess — any tooling to rekey automatically?

jess: I have a small script but it assumes fp16. question: do we want to convert/store as fp16 or bf16 for this model? target infra (Dedicated) is Ampere with bf16 support but we saw slight quality diffs on some tests with bf16 earlier. suggestions?

tariq: default to fp16 for now (consistent with existing orion variants) unless RE team requests bf16 later. we'll keep a bf16 recipe.

maya: thanks. i'll run the rekey + safetensors rewrite to remove tp rank prefixes and produce interleaved shards, then quant check. sharing the command i plan to run:

maya: ```
python tools/rekey_and_pack.py \
  --input s3://redwood-models/orion-lite/v1/weights-00001.safetensors \
  --config s3://redwood-models/orion-lite/v1/config.json \
  --tp-prefix "transformer.h.*.attn.*.tp" \
  --out s3://redwood-models/orion-lite/packaged/v1/ \
  --dtype float16 
```

maya: packager-bot, can you lint the output path and validate config once done? :pray:

packager-bot: Received request: validating path s3://redwood-models/orion-lite/packaged/v1/ after upload

packager-bot: Quick checks:
- safetensors index present : yes
- shard count matches config.expected_shards : no (expected 8, found 16)
- tokenizer special token mismatch : detected ('<unk>' vs '<|unk|>')
- tp layout: normalized to interleaved : pending (rekey tool applied?)

maya: noted — the rekey script created 16 smaller shards (we split per-tp then repacked; i can collapse back to 8). i'll res-run with --target-shards 8. also i'll patch tokenizer.json to standard tokens and upload a tokenizer-compat.json with both forms for compatibility.

simon: sounds good. after you resubmit, i'll run serve-readiness smoke (start perf runner + kv cache warm). if packager-bot reports clean, let's queue a canary deploy to staging. :thumbsup:

tariq: small heads-up — after repack keep a copy of original tp-prefixed safetensors in an archive bucket with metadata: exporter_version, export_command, tp_layout. we've lost context before and it caused headaches.

maya: will do. thanks everyone — i'll post updates here when the 8-shard rewrite completes and attach the new manifest.

packager-bot: Note: remember to add model.metadata: {"tested_dtype":"fp16","packager_version":"0.14.2"} to manifest on upload (manual if needed).

maya: added metadata and kicked off rewrite. ETA ~20min. :hourglass:
